preconditions: P5.2 implementation installed on disposable Odoo 18
gates.data: two long read-only turns in independent conversations
gates.action: set effective capacity to 2, enqueue both turns through the authenticated product route and observe durable states plus scheduler diagnostics
gates.backend_expected: two independent conversations can overlap in running state without double claim or cross-conversation serialization
gates.browser_expected: browser remains responsive and both durable turns are observable independently
gates.cleanup: restore original capacity and cancel unresolved read-only turns

gates.data: two long read-only turns in the same conversation
gates.action: start the first turn, enqueue a second turn into the same conversation while the first is unresolved, then release the predecessor
gates.backend_expected: the second turn remains queued while its causal predecessor is running/cancelling and becomes eligible only after the predecessor reaches a terminal state
gates.browser_expected: status polling shows the durable ordering without duplicate/restarted turns
gates.cleanup: restore capacity and cancel unresolved turns

gates.data: two long read-only turns in independent conversations
gates.action: set effective capacity to 1, hold one turn running, enqueue another, observe queued backpressure, then release the running turn
gates.backend_expected: active_count never exceeds one; excess work remains queued rather than failed and is woken promptly after capacity release
gates.browser_expected: normal authenticated browser/RPC activity remains usable while one turn waits
gates.cleanup: restore original capacity and cancel unresolved turns
